_comment: Règles propres à chaque héros, appliquées par-dessus skills.json (calc/damage.apply_mechanics). Clé = clé du héros dans skills.json. Par compétence : 'set' (champs remplacés : trigger, no_crit, aoe...), 'effects' (liste remplacée), 'effects_add' (effets ajoutés). Types d'effets : calc/battle.EFFECT_TYPES. Chaque règle cite le texte du jeu qu'elle traduit ('source') ; voir docs/SIMULATORS.md.

s2.source: Cannot receive recover Health effects and damage sharing effects.

s1.source: When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit.

s1_bis.source: When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit.

s3.source: When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit.

s2.source: At the start of an ally's turn, dispels one debuff from the target and recovers Health proportional to the caster's max Health.

s3.source: Dispels all debuffs from an ally except for the caster before fully recovering Health. Grants superhumanization to the target for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 50%. When the target is already dead, revives them with 100% Health.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy, inflicting up to 10% injuries and recovering the caster's Health. When it is not the caster's turn, damage dealt and injuries are doubled.

s1_wind.source: After attacking, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all Fighting Spirit to activate Wind of Protection: grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) to all allies for 2 turns, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 35%. (s2) At the start of the first battle, gains 50 Fighting Spirit.

s2.source: Grants 40% damage sharing from the damage received by the ally. After an ally except for the caster is attacked, when the damage suffered is 20% or more of max Health, dispels all debuffs and counterattacks.

s3.source: Attacks the enemy with a shield, inflicting up to 20% injuries. (La réduction de recharge n'existe qu'en âme brûlée.)

s1.source: (Rhianna) inflicting erosion for 2 turns. A critical hit will detonate erosion effects. (Luciella) After granting increased Attack to the caster for 1 turn, attacks the enemy and absorbs some of the damage dealt as health. (Érosion non définie par E7GW : non simulée.)

s3.source: Luciella attacks all enemies and ignores damage sharing. Rhianna dispels two buffs from all enemies, before inflicting fear for 1 turn.

s2.source: After being attacked, increases Combat Readiness by 20%.

s2_stand.source: At the start of battle, when the caster is in the front row, grants Ferocious Stand for 1 turn (allies except for the bearer cannot be selected as a target).

s2_stand_end.source: At the end of the turn, when the caster is in the front row, grants Ferocious Stand for 1 turn.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy and has a 75% chance to inflict fear for 1 turn, before recovering Health of all allies proportional to the target's max Health.

s2.source: At the start of battle, grants offering to the foremost ally (70% damage sharing of the damage received by all allies; immortality once upon lethal damage).

s2_death.source: When the ally granted offering dies, recovers Health of all allies by 50%.

s3.source: Dispels all debuffs from all allies before increasing Combat Readiness by 25%. Consumes 20% of the current Health of the ally granted offering, granting abundance to all other allies for 2 turns (after attacking, 2,000 additional damage).

s1.source: Rapidly attacks two enemies with a swordstorm, with a 50% chance to decrease their Combat Readiness by 15%.

s3.source: Attacks all enemies, decreasing Hit Chance for 2 turns. When the enemy is defeated with this skill, cooldown does not occur.

s1.source: After inflicting rupture on the enemy for 1 turn, attacks the enemy. When the caster is granted immortality, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

s2.source: At the start of battle, grants immortality for 1 turn. When granted immortality, increases Effect Resistance by 200%.

s2_dark_moon.source: When someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating Dark Moon: dispels two buffs from all enemies, before granting immortality to the caster for 3 turns and increasing Combat Readiness by 35%.

s2.source: When an ally's Health is 50% or less after being attacked, activates La Vie en Rose: dispels two debuffs from all allies and recovers Health before granting a barrier for 2 turns (proportional to the caster's max Health). (Parfum persistant non défini par E7GW : non simulé.)

s3.source: After granting increased Effectiveness to the caster for 3 turns, with a 100% chance to inflict two venom effects on all enemies for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates venom effects inflicted on the target.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with an anchor, and grants a barrier to all allies for 1 turn. (Le tour supplémentaire n'appartient qu'à Power Strike.)

s1_power.source: At the start of the turn, when Focus is full, changes to Power Strike (Consume 5 Focus): attacks the enemy, and grants an extra turn to the caster. Penetrates the target's Defense. (s2) At the start of battle, gains 3 Focus. (Gain de Concentration non précisé : +1 par tour, estimé.)

s2.source: At the start of battle, gains 3 Focus, and has a 70% (max 100%) chance to grant indomitable to all allies for 1 turn.

s2_reset.source: At the start of the turn, when the caster has a buff, dispels all debuffs from the caster and resets skill cooldown of Anchor Shot.

s3.source: Attacks the enemy with an anchor, absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health, and granting morale to all allies for 2 turns. (Compétence active : E7GW n'indique pas de recharge, valeur par défaut.)

s2.source: Attacks the enemy in a dimensional corridor, with a 75% (max 100%) chance each to dispel two buffs before fully increasing skill cooldowns. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s3.source: Attacks all enemies with an explosion and grants increased Speed to the caster for 2 turns. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s1_subspace.source: When the caster is granted mana field (Fighting Spirit 10 or more), consumes 10 Fighting Spirit to attack a random enemy with the same skill as an extra attack. (s3) At the start of the first battle, gains maximum Fighting Spirit.
